sullengard_arantxa_10.m: I saw you talking with Gaelian and many other people in town. May I ask about what?
r: I'm looking into the armory break-in and robbery.

sullengard_arantxa_20.m: Are you sure that you want to involve yourself in such affairs?

sullengard_arantxa_30.m: Well I don't know much. All I know is 'the lost traveler', whom I've never seen before, approached me recently with a couple of items that he wanted me to buy.

sullengard_arantxa_40.m: Since I recognized a couple of them as being Zaccheria's, I refused to buy them.
r: Really? That's honestly the only reason why you didn't buy them?

sullengard_arantxa_50.m: What is that supposed to mean?
r: Well, let's be honest. You are a thief after all.

sullengard_arantxa_60.m: You see kid, here in Sullengard, we have a working agreement with the townspeople. They pay us for our services and we do not steal from them.

sullengard_arantxa_70.m: Now if I were you, I would approach 'the lost traveler' very carefully. He is desperate and desperate people have been known to be unpredictable.
r: Thank you, friend and I will be careful.

sullengard_arantxa_sell.m: Do you want to take a look at any of 'my stuff'? It's all for sale at the right price.
r: Yes. I could use some item upgrades.
